outcome: successful medication management for missed miscarriage
unsuccessful medication management for missed miscarriage
cohort: Participants were patients aged 16 years and older, diagnosed with a missed miscarriage in the first 13 weeks of pregnancy, who chose medication management.
finding: The study found that a history of parity, prior uterine surgery, and exposure to reduced visibility were independently associated with an increased risk of unsuccessful medication management for missed miscarriage, while supplemental vaginal misoprostol did not improve success.
mod_finding: Prior caesarean section history was identified as a risk factor for unsuccessful medication management of missed miscarriage.
gest_age: first 13 weeks of pregnancy (by last menstrual period)
